# Boundaries controls

An external accepted policy forbids example.com/fixture/ui from importing example.com/fixture/storage. The bad UI bypasses that boundary; the good UI calls the service. The policy must be supplied to both runs; without it the layering is only a preference.

Use the lifecycle fixture's temporary-repository procedure. Keep this README
and variant names outside model inputs. Record coverage, model and prompt
versions, usage and unexpected findings; one pair cannot establish precision.
